name: 协作看板
description: 人和 agent 共用的看板：本机看板记录这台电脑上的工作，群看板供群成员和各自的 agent 共同推进。卡片可关联任务并显示运行状态、进度和等待事项；agent 通过工具认领、更新和推进卡片。
subtitle: 人和 agent 共用的看板

en.name: Teamboard
en.description: A board people and agents share: this computer's board for your own work, and a chat's board everyone in it and their agents move forward together. Cards link tasks and show their status, progress and what they wait on; agents claim, update and move cards with tools.
en.subtitle: A board for people and agents
